name: Build a modern, minimal, single-page portfolio

messages.content:
Build a modern, minimal, single-page portfolio website for Jasil KJ, a first-year B.Tech CSE (AI) student at Thejus Engineering College, Thrissur.

DESIGN REFERENCE (attached screenshot): Match its look and feel closely.
- Dark theme: near-black navy background (#05030F) with deep purple/violet radial gradient glows
- Hero with a glossy 3D glass/chrome purple abstract shape (use a CSS/SVG/Three.js glass torus-knot or a gradient blob) at the bottom of the hero, partly cropped
- Small pill badge above the headline (e.g. "✦ Open to opportunities")
- Large bold headline, tight letter-spacing, with the last word in a white → lavender → violet gradient
- Font: Inter (or Geist), clean and modern
- Pill-shaped buttons: one solid white (primary), one dark translucent with a subtle border (secondary)
- Floating, centered navbar with a logo on the left, links in the middle, and a white pill CTA on the right
- Glassmorphism cards (translucent, thin 1px borders, soft blur), generous whitespace, rounded corners (16–24px)

SECTIONS
1. Hero: Badge "AI & CSE Student". Headline "Hi, I'm Jasil KJ / Building Smarter Things with AI" (gradient on "Smarter" or "AI"). Subtext: "First-year B.Tech CSE (AI) student at Thejus Engineering College, Thrissur, passionate about AI, code, and building real projects." Buttons: "View Projects" and "Download Resume".
2. About: My portrait photo (attached image 2) in a rounded frame with a soft purple glow, beside a short bio and quick facts (College, Branch, Location: Thrissur, Kerala).
3. Skills: Glass cards or pills for Python, C, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Git, and Machine Learning basics. Add a "Currently learning" row.
4. Projects: 3 glass cards with image placeholder, title, description, tech tags, and GitHub/Live links (use placeholder content I can edit easily).
5. Education & Timeline: Simple vertical timeline with B.Tech CSE (AI) at Thejus Engineering College.
6. Contact: Short heading, email button, and GitHub/LinkedIn/Instagram icons. Simple contact form.
7. Footer: "© 2026 Jasil KJ".

INTERACTIONS
- Smooth scroll, sticky blurred navbar with active-link highlight
- Subtle fade-up on scroll, a slow floating animation on the 3D shape, a soft hover glow/lift on cards and buttons
- Fully responsive (mobile-first) with a hamburger menu on mobile

TECH
- Next.js + Tailwind CSS (or plain HTML/CSS/JS if simpler), Framer Motion for animations, lucide-react for icons
- Keep the code clean and componentized, with all personal content in one config/data file so I can easily edit it
- Good Lighting/accessibility: high contrast text, semantic HTML, alt text, fast loading

Keep the overall design simple, elegant, and uncluttered. Less is more.
